title: A Roth conversion this year, at 52, in the 24 percent bracket
variant: Stacked numbered lists, a full sentence per point
prompt: Pros and cons of doing a Roth conversion this year; I'm 52, in the 24% bracket, with $400k in a traditional IRA.
note: Stacked rather than side by side, with serif headings, because every point needs a full sentence of arithmetic and two narrow columns would have squeezed them: pros as a numbered list, then cons, each point carrying its weight as a phrase beneath it that also says why. A three-row table of the numbers that decide it sits between the lists and the bottom line, and the bottom line is a bordered box with a serif sentence rather than a dark strip, so the page stays quiet and paper-like for a reader who will hand it to an accountant.
